features.name: Pick who you are
features.does: Lets a person choose their name from the members, so everything they do is in their name.

features.name: Start a product
features.does: Lists the products and starts a new one from a name and an idea.

features.name: Keep the keys
features.does: Holds the keys to the outside services and the GitHub account, each with a light that says whether it works.

features.name: Take a test drive
features.does: Runs the whole loop on the sample product and says in words whether it passed.

features.name: Show a product as a lakefront
features.does: Draws a product as buildings by a lake, one for each thing it does, with its code a level inside.

features.name: Agree what to build
features.does: Writes down each decision as a card that is decided only by a named yes.

features.name: Show the real screens
features.does: Shows the product’s own screens, each figure with where it comes from.

features.name: Walk through and sign
features.does: Walks through each screen with the customer, who signs it in their own name.

features.name: Get a second opinion
features.does: Has an auditor from another vendor check every part and sign its own report.

features.name: Hand over the keys
features.does: Hands the finished product to its owner, with what they need to keep improving it.

features.name: Run the pod floor
features.does: Books pods, shows each pod’s work and counts the products in use.

features.name: The sample chai stall
features.does: A small product that Test drive builds and checks from start to finish.
